items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: And I give studio classes with his students all the time.

ctx.x: Oh sure. And sometimes the jazz guys are a little bit better versed at playing in a brass quintet than the brass quintet guys are, because of style more than anything. So that’s something that we work on. And I give studio classes with his students all the time. Because he’s of the opinion that in the future, and I agree with him, in the future a symphonic trumpet section might consist of a principal player and then a second player, and then a guy that can play lead on some pop stuff, and then a guy that can…
